expiration.description: Number of minutes before the temporary output link expires.

httppassword.description: HTTP password when the source URL requires authentication.

httpusername.description: HTTP username when the source URL requires authentication.

inline.description: Whether to return the generated PDF content in the response.

name.description: File name for the generated PDF.

profiles.description: Advanced PDF.co profile settings as a JSON string or JSON object.

url.description: Public URL of the source XLS, XLSX, or CSV file.

worksheetIndex.description: Zero-based index of the worksheet to convert, provided as a string; the first worksheet is '0'.

200.description: Tool result data
